{{Quote|I suspect they want to open a trade route to Vena. But if that's is the Baroness' goal, she will first need our help to bring unity to her own troubled star system.|[[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] to [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]|<ref name="Last1" />}}
The '''Vena system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vena]].

==History==
Descended from early [[Hapan]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], the [[Venan]]s had a tradition of maintaining an independent and isolationist stance on their system, remaining unaffiliated from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], even though they shared a good relationship and the Venans would occasionally trade with the nearby [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="btr">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020411crise&c=rpg|text=Before the Rise}}</ref>

In [[3962 BBY]], the Galactic Republic was [[Battle of the Vena system|engaged]] by [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in the Vena system as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], an ongoing conflict between the two groups. The battle took place because the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were advancing through a number of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in an attempt to conquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. This assault, called [[Mandalorian Triumph]], brought the Mandalorian forces from their territory [[Battle of the Nazzri system (Mandalorian Wars)|through]] the [[Nazzri system/Legends|Nazzri system]], which they took before launching their attack on the Vena [[Star system/Legends|system]] and winning there as well. Afterward, the Mandalorian forces passed through the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]], where they had [[First battle of Onderon (Mandalorian Wars)|taken]] the planet of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] earlier in the war,<ref name="TEA" /> to rendezvous with forces on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], that planet's moon.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The combined army then [[Battle of the Ambria system|claimed]] the [[Ambria system/Legends|Ambria system]] before continuing Coreward.<ref name="TEA" />

Circa [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], the rise of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Kindoro]] and Baroness [[Omnino]] to power on [[Vena]] changed their historic isolationist position. Due to the fact that Kindoro and Omnino had been both [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], this contact with outsiders motivated an economic deregulation and active foreign policy, including trade agreements, in order to make goods accessible to the Venan royal family.<ref name="btr" />

This radical shift angered many Venans, who resented the fact that only the royal family was benefitting from the economic opening. The [[Vena Isolationists|commoners]] called for a return to isolationism and the old-fashioned values. The regents, unwilling to give in to popular demands, imprisoned the movement leaders and sent them to labor camps. This move aggravated tensions and motivated the emergence of terrorism and sabotage against Venan nobility.<ref name="btr" />

This conflict was worsened with the death of Kindoro, as Baroness Omnino proved herself even more unmerciful than her husband, and waged open, [[Venan civil war|bloody war]] for years against her subjects,<ref name="btr" /> until her death in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]].<ref name="Last3" />
